items.headline: SkyAI Dumps Half Its $SOL Bag for $201M Buyback
items.summary: SkyAI sold half of its $SOL treasury to fund a massive $201 million cash buyback of $SKYAI, a bold treasury pivot turning heads onchain.

items.headline: $APT Fights MEV With New Encrypted Mempool
items.summary: Aptos launched an encrypted mempool designed to curb MEV exploitation and shield user transactions, a fresh DeFi edge for the $APT ecosystem.

items.headline: $ONDO Teams With Tradexyz for New RWA Push
items.summary: $ONDO is joining forces with Tradexyz to expand its real-world asset offerings, doubling down on the red-hot tokenization narrative.

items.headline: Canton Coin Burns as Network Books $155M Q3 Fees
items.summary: Canton recorded over $155 million in Q3 fees per CertiK, with $CC burned for network services — one of the top fee-generating chains right now.

items.headline: $ENS v2 Proposal Would Freeze v1 Registrations
items.summary: A new proposal to activate ENSv2 would halt all new ENSv1 name registrations, marking a major migration moment for the $ENS ecosystem.
